r0.why: Fundamental rule relating marginal to conditional (1), total over several events hence the name (2), summation (4)

r1.why: Summation as weighted average, 'average'/'overall probability' (4), zero-probability terms omitted since finite (3)

r3.why: Weighting 99% by 60% and 95% by 40% (6, 7) gives 97.4% (10), which follows arithmetically

r4.why: Law of alternatives for discrete case (11), other authors' names (12), Grimmett and Welsh partition theorem and total expectation (13)
